emotional_tone: Professional, reliable, analytical, clean, modern enterprise

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black tracking-tight leading-none text-slate-900
scale.label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-500

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing around layout containers, dense spacing within data widgets.
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Dense, Data Correlation). Base: grid-cols-12. Gap: gap-4 or gap-6.

surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat solid backgrounds (bg-white), sharp edges or max 4px radius, 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), NO shadows. Optical alignment for metrics.
surface_strategies.header: Solid white background, 1px border-b border-slate-200. Sticky top.
surface_strategies.interactive_elements: Hover states must have higher contrast, e.g., hover:bg-slate-100 for subtle items, or hover:bg-slate-800 for primary buttons. Focus rings must be clear and blue.

shadcn_customizations.card: Remove default shadow. Use border-slate-200. Reduce border-radius to rounded-sm.
shadcn_customizations.button: Use sharp corners (rounded-sm). Primary button bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white. Secondary button bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-900.
shadcn_customizations.table: Dense padding (py-2 px-4). Header text uppercase, xs, high tracking. Rows have subtle border-b.
shadcn_customizations.chart: Use Recharts. Minimalist axes (no grid lines or very faint stroke-slate-100). Colors must match the primary accent colors (blue, teal, orange). No default legends, build custom HTML legends.

custom_elements.metric_widget: Contains an overline label, a massive metric value, and a small trend indicator (green/red) with a Lucide arrow icon.
custom_elements.live_feed: A vertical scrolling list or dense table with real-time updates (use simple CSS keyframes for a pulsing 'live' dot).

images.description: Abstract minimalist data visualization background, soft neutrals, representing flight paths.
Group of people in modern airport terminal (useful for contextual side panels or login).
Bustling airport scene with travelers on moving walkway.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for standard text against background. Metric values must pop.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, links, and key metric displays MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a complete full-stack app with React frontend and FastAPI backend.
Use the Control Room grid system. The dashboard should look dense, precise, and highly analytical. No excessive whitespace inside data widgets.
Replace default Inter font with Chivo for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body.
Build a real-time live operational feed component mimicking web-socket updates.
Embed Recharts for data visualization (distribution, predictions, comparisons).
Use the provided image URLs for the login screen background and any dashboard header graphics.
